name: Dumbbell Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and toes turned slightly out, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with palms facing inward.
Brace your core, keep your chest upright, and sit your hips back and down by bending your hips and knees together.
Lower as far as you can while keeping both feet flat and your back steady.
Drive through your midfoot and heels to extend your hips and knees back to the starting stance.
tips: Keep the dumbbells hanging straight at your sides without letting them pull your shoulders forward into a rounded back.
Track your knees in line with your toes throughout both the descent and ascent.
